table_title: Monthly runoff, water year October 1965 to September 1966
site_name: Boulder Creek at Cuyamaca Reservoir, near Julian, Calif.
location_text: Lat 32°59'20", long 116°35'10", in NE¼ sec.5, T.14 S., R.4 E., on outlet tower at Cuyamaca Dam, 7 miles south of Julian.
quantities_units: gage height (feet); contents (acre-feet); change in contents (acre-feet); draft (acre-feet); evaporation (acre-feet); spill plus leakage (acre-feet); discharge (acre-feet)
notes: Water type is the hard field: the station is a stream station (Boulder Creek; discharge = inflow to Cuyamaca Reservoir computed from reservoir records) but most columns are reservoir quantities (gage height and contents are under a 'Cuyamaca Reservoir' sub-heading). Chose Stream Discharge because of the station name and the title 'Monthly runoff'; Reservoir is defensible. Rows are month-end dates Sept. 30 (1965) to Sept. 30 (1966), plus 'Calendar year 1965' and 'Water year 1965-66' totals. County not printed. Heading 'SAN DIEGO RIVER BASIN'. Everything else sure.
